sources.excerpt: e are created by a system comprising two types of institutions: central bank of the economy and the commercial banking system. Central bank Central Bank is a very important institution in a modern economy. Almost every country has one central bank. India got its central bank in 1935. Its name is the ‘Reserve Bank of India’. Central bank has several important functions. It issues the currency of the country.
